embedding.description: The cell embedding: the <cls> token's embedding (the maker's default emb_mode cls).

mean_embedding.description: The gene-token embeddings averaged over the cell's genes (the maker's emb_mode cell), from the same layer.

genes_used.description: Number of genes the model read.

genes_skipped.description: Number of given gene IDs missing from the model's dictionary.

genes_truncated.description: Number of lowest-ranked genes dropped beyond the 4,094-gene limit.
